instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium-wide shot, eye-level. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls, the man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing right. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing left. They stand close together, clasping hands in a handshake. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the dominant red carpet.
